cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20.0)

find_package(Zephyr REQUIRED HINTS $ENV{ZEPHYR_BASE})
project(test_model_ota_slot_library)

include(${ZEPHYR_EDGE_AI_MODULE_DIR}/lib/model_ota/cmake/slot.cmake)
include(${ZEPHYR_EDGE_AI_MODULE_DIR}/lib/model_ota/cmake/backends/axon.cmake)

# Each slot gets a hand-written model_ota_axon_model_config.h instead of one generated by
# model_ota_axon_inspect(), so no Axon model header is needed.
foreach(slot first second)
  model_ota_add_slot_library(
    TARGET ${slot}
    SOURCE ${MODEL_OTA_AXON_SLOT_SRC}
    PARTITION_NODELABEL model_${slot}_storage
    INCLUDES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/slots/${slot}
  )
endforeach()

target_sources(app PRIVATE src/main.c)
target_include_directories(app PRIVATE ${ZEPHYR_EDGE_AI_MODULE_DIR}/lib/model_ota/include)
target_compile_definitions(app PRIVATE MODEL_OTA_IMAGE_OFFSET=${MODEL_OTA_IMAGE_OFFSET})
